name: rule_id
description: Unique identifier for the compliance rule.

name: category
description: Category the rule belongs to (e.g., trading_limits, data_privacy).

name: severity
description: Severity level of the rule (e.g., low, medium, high, critical).

name: jurisdictions
description: Array of jurisdictions this rule applies to.

name: parameters
description: JSON object for any specific parameters related to the rule.

name: check_function_name
description: Name of the function used to check this rule.
